record.one_liner: YouTube transcript, search, channel and playlist data via a REST API and an MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Users sign in with a TranscriptAPI API key (Bearer token per the docs). OAuth is offered only for some MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT), connecting to the vendor's own MCP server, not a third-party OAuth grant for the REST API.
record.access_notes: Free account with 100 credits and no card required; paid plan is $5/month for 1,000 credits.
record.api_notes: Read-only YouTube data endpoints: transcripts, search, channel uploads, playlists, handle resolution.
